class.name: FlowVariableNode
class.brief_description: Base class of the nodes that access a variable of a [FlowGraph].
class.description: [FlowVariableNode] holds the name of a variable. It is the base class of [FlowGetVariableNode] and [FlowSetVariableNode] and can't be instantiated itself. The name must be declared in [member FlowGraph.variables]; otherwise [method FlowGraph.validate] reports [constant FlowGraphValidation.ISSUE_KIND_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE]. An empty name is a configuration warning of the node.

members.member: The name of the variable, as declared by a [FlowVariable] in [member FlowGraph.variables].
